description: This file defines an interface IServiceRuntimeWrapper and its implementation ServiceRuntimeWrapper that provides a reflection-based wrapper around Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ServiceRuntime.dll, used for Azure worker and web roles to access runtime information and handle shutdown events. It is part of the Orleans hosting infrastructure for Azure environments.

classes.name: IServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Interface exposing methods to access Azure role runtime information and manage stopping notifications.

classes.name: ServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of IServiceRuntimeWrapper that uses reflection to interact with Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ServiceRuntime.dll for Azure role environment details.

methods.name: GetIPEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IP endpoint for a given endpoint name in the Azure role.

methods.name: GetConfigurationSettingValue
methods.description: Returns the configuration setting value for a given key.

methods.name: SubscribeForStoppingNotification
methods.description: Subscribes a handler for the role stopping event.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStoppingNotification
methods.description: Unsubscribes a handler from the role stopping event.
